summary.text: One of the twenty-three suitors from Same on Cephallenia in Apollodorus' catalogue — a namesake of Perimedes the comrade of Odysseus who bound him to the mast past the Sirens.

story.text: Apollodorus names Perimedes among the wooers assigned to Same, listed after Cerberus and before Cynnus in Epitome 7.28.
Homer's Odyssey knows another Perimedes — one of Odysseus' trusty comrades who held the victims at the pit of Ocean and tightened the bonds when the Sirens sang — not this Cephallenian wooer.
